items.title: Show HN: SagaShield – ACID transactions and security guardrails for AI agents
items.summary: SagaShield是基于Rust的高性能AI Agent运行时，为自主Agent提供类数据库的ACID事务保障，解决长工具链调用中的状态不一致、无回滚
items.summary_en: SagaShield is a high-performance Rust runtime that gives autonomous AI agents ACID-compliant transactions via the Saga pattern, including FSM-based tool authorization, a Step-0 security guard against prompt injection, SQLite write-ahead logging, and LIFO rollback compensation on failure. It ships with a Python SDK (decorator API + LangChain adapter), a standalone MCP server, built-in OpenTelemetry audit export, and a deterministic 50-scenario evaluation suite with fuzzing targets. The project includes 37 integration tests and aims to solve compounding errors, missing rollbacks, and tool-level prompt injection in production agent workflows.

items.title: Show HN: Blackholes – A macOS workspace for coding agents
items.summary: Blackholes 是一款开源 macOS 应用，用于组织 coding agents、Git 仓库和终端。它支持 Claude、Codex、Gemini 和 OpenCode 等多个 AI 编程工具，可同时管理前端和后端仓库下的任务分支和 worktrees。应用采用 Rust 和 React 开发，源码发布于 GitHub。
items.summary_en: Blackholes is an open-source macOS app built with Rust and React that organizes coding agents, Git repositories, and terminals into unified workspaces. It supports multiple repositories per project and allows tasks to have their own branches and worktrees across frontend and backend repos. Compatible with Claude, Codex, Gemini, and OpenCode, it provides notes, file editing, and Git diffs within a single interface.

items.title: Show HN: Text-to-SQL says "no records found" when it should say "denied"
items.summary: Schemagate 是一款解决 Text-to-SQL 权限问题的工具，它在模型看到 schema 之前进行身份感知的表选择，只挑选调用者有权访问的必要表，避免模型因行级安全过滤后返回错误的"no records found"。实测中，对于 260 个对象的数据库，每日 5000 次查询，月成本可从约 7200 美元降至约 200 美元，并在 1789 个测试用例上验证了表排序的准确性。
items.summary_en: Schemagate is an open-source Python library that pre-filters database schema tables by user identity and role before an LLM generates SQL, preventing unauthorized tables from reaching the prompt and avoiding misleading "no records found" responses. It uses a BM25-based selector to consistently narrow schemas to roughly six relevant tables, cutting token costs dramatically — in one measured case, reducing monthly spend from ~$7,200 to ~$200 on a 260-table schema handling 5,000 queries daily — and includes a no-install browser demo and migration guide from Vanna.

items.title: Enciclopedia web
items.summary: 我使用Google Gemini辅助开发了一个鸟类网络百科全书，技术栈采用HTML、CSS、JS和PHP。代码托管在GitHub，通过Render平台执行PHP部署上线，网站地址为 https://avesdiversas.onrender.com/。
items.summary_en: The author built a web encyclopedia about birds with assistance from Google Gemini, using a tech stack of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and PHP. The project's code is stored on GitHub and deployed via Render, and it is live at avesdiversas.onrender.com.

items.title: 感谢用GPT-6搓3D的！燃烧自己的token换来一次全体重置
items.summary: GPT-6 Astra在3D领域掀起热潮，已涌现出4类典型应用：根据图纸生成3295个独立对象的可编辑火车模型、43分钟内构建覆盖26.7万个简化建筑且基于Three.js渲染的"迷你首尔"3D网页、单次运行45分钟生成赛博废土风3D游戏Demo，以及30分钟内完成的人体细胞3D可视化场景。由于玩家大量消耗额度，OpenAI面向所有付费订阅用户进行全局重置，预计美西时间当天18点左右到账。
items.summary_en: GPT-6 Astra has sparked a viral wave of AI-powered 3D creation, with users rapidly burning through token quotas generating Blender models, browser-based city scenes (like a mini-Seoul with ~267K buildings), and playable 3D games—all orchestrated through Python scripting across Blender, Three.js, and Unreal Engine. In response to the massive usage spike, OpenAI CEO Sam Altman issued a global usage reset for all paid subscribers (Plus, Pro, Business), expected to land around 18:00 PST on the 8th, marking yet another token refund in a pattern that has become routine for the platform.

items.title: Meta debuts its Muse AI agent. Will consumers trust it?
items.summary: Meta推出个人AI助手Muse，底层基于Muse Spark模型，可连接邮箱、日历、支付、健康等日常应用，自动完成发邮件、订票、购物、填表等任务，支付环节接入Stripe Link并支持Apple Pay。产品已上线muse.ai、iOS和Android应用及WhatsApp，未来还将登陆Meta AI眼镜，采用免费层+付费订阅模式，Power版20美元/月，Maximum版100美元/月。
items.summary_en: Meta has launched Muse, a personal AI agent powered by its Muse Spark model, available in the U.S. via muse.ai, iOS, Android, WhatsApp, and soon Meta AI glasses. The agent connects to users' everyday apps—email, calendars, payments, health, smart home, and shopping—to autonomously execute tasks like booking travel, sending emails, lowering bills, and making purchases through Stripe Link. It operates on a free tier with two paid subscriptions at $20/month (Power) and $100/month (Maximum), and will continue functioning and learning from users even when they step away from the app.

items.title: 单人一月烧掉 19 万，硅谷开始倒查员工 AI 账单
items.summary_en: Microsoft is auditing employee AI spending after one staffer burned through $28,000 (≈190,000 RMB) in just 28 days, while CoreAI department usage hit a median of $975/month—over three times the company-wide median of $300. The crackdown includes department-level budgets, individual spending dashboards, and a switch to OpenAI's GPT-5.6 Sol as the default model, responding to a culture of "tokenmaxxing" where employees inflated usage for performative visibility rather than productivity, a pattern also seen at Meta and Uber with internal leaderboard competitions.

items.title: openai/skills
items.summary: OpenAI 发布了 Codex Skills 仓库，提供 Agent Skills 的目录与安装指南。Agent Skills 是通过 .system 文件打包的指令与脚本组合，支持团队复用特定任务能力。用户可使用 $skill-installer 命令安装 curated 或 experimental 技能，例如执行 `$skill-installer gh-address-comments` 安装技能后重启 Codex 即可生效。该仓库已标记为 deprecated，新技能开发建议迁移至 OpenAI Plugins 仓库。
items.summary_en: OpenAI has deprecated its skills repository, directing users to the OpenAI Plugins repository for current skill and plugin examples. Agent Skills are reusable folders of instructions, scripts, and resources that Codex discovers and applies to perform specific tasks consistently. Curated and experimental skills are installed via the `$skill-installer` command within Codex, with `.system` skills auto-installed automatically.

items.title: GPT-6 Astra推理等级怎么选才最省Token
items.summary: GPT-6 Astra的推理强度等级（Reasoning Effort）提供多档思考预算选择，各档位为同一模型的不同处理深度。Ultra档位相当于拉起多个智能体协作的专项工作组。
items.summary_en: GPT-6 Astra features adjustable Reasoning Effort levels, where each tier allocates a different thinking budget to the same underlying model. The Ultra tier operates differently, functioning like a specialized task force with multiple collaborative agents. Selecting the appropriate level strategically can minimize token consumption without sacrificing output quality.

items.title: This AI entrepreneur is developing agents that can plan ahead for the unexpected
items.summary: Danijar Hafner正在创立一家秘密模式的公司，继续推进基于模型强化学习的世界模型
items.summary_en: Danijar Hafner, a former Google Brain and Google DeepMind researcher, is launching a stealth-mode startup building AI agents using model-based reinforcement learning and world models to navigate unfamiliar physical environments. His prior breakthroughs include Dreamer 4, which learned Minecraft diamond mining from offline video data without direct game interaction. The startup is now migrating these agents from virtual simulations into real-world humanoids imported from China, enabling robots to handle unseen scenarios without traditional trial-and-error training.

directions.name: AgentLedger
directions.description: 面向独立开发者的轻量级 AI Agent 事务管理与自动回滚服务，让多步骤 AI 调用具备数据库级别的可靠性。
directions.description_en: A lightweight ACID transaction and auto-rollback service for indie developers building multi-step AI agents.
directions.target_user: 独立开发者、一人公司创始人，正在构建需要多工具链调用的 AI Agent 应用。
directions.target_user_en: Indie developers and solo founders building AI agents that require multi-step toolchain calls.
core_features: 基于 SQLite 的轻量 ACID 事务日志
兼容 LangChain、LlamaIndex 等主流 Agent 框架
core_features_en: Compatible with popular frameworks like LangChain and LlamaIndex
related_trends: 开源 Agent 基础设施
directions.why_now: Hacker News Show HN 社区对 SagaShield 的讨论显示，开发者普遍反映当前 AI Agent 在长工具链调用中经常出现状态不一致、无法回滚的问题（HN 帖子评论区多次提到 'rollbacks are painful' 和 'state loss ruins everything'）。SagaShield 采用 Rust 虽然性能好但学习成本高，独立开发者需要一个更轻量的解决方案。
directions.why_now_en: The Hacker News community discussion around SagaShield reveals that developers commonly report state inconsistency and lack of rollback in long toolchain AI Agent calls (multiple commenters mentioned 'rollbacks are painful' and 'state loss ruins everything'). While SagaShield uses Rust for performance, it has a steep learning curve, leaving room for a lighter-weight solution for indie developers.
directions.monetization: 开源核心 SDK + 付费云服务（托管事务日志、监控面板），定价 $9/月起
directions.monetization_en: Open-source core SDK + paid cloud service (hosted transaction logs and monitoring dashboard), starting at $9/month
directions.source_article: Show HN: SagaShield – ACID transactions and security guardrails for AI agents

directions.name: RepoPilot
directions.description: 面向独立开发者的跨平台 AI 编程工作台，统一管理 Claude、Codex、Gemini 等多 Agent 的任务分支与 Git worktree。
directions.description_en: A cross-platform AI coding workspace for indie developers to unify task branches and Git worktrees across Claude, Codex, and Gemini agents.
directions.target_user: 独立开发者、一人公司技术创始人，同时在多个 AI 编程工具间切换管理前端/后端仓库。
directions.target_user_en: Indie developers and solo technical founders who juggle multiple AI coding tools while managing frontend and backend repositories.
core_features: 多 Agent 任务看板（Kanban）视图
一键创建隔离 Git worktree
前端/后端仓库联动任务分配
directions.why_now: Blackholes 在 Hacker News 获得 7/10 评分并获得关注，说明市场需求真实存在。但 Blackholes 仅限 macOS，Linux/Windows 用户及跨平台需求的独立开发者是空白市场。评论区有用户明确表示 'I wish this worked on Linux' 和 'need this for my WSL setup'，显示跨平台版本有明确付费意愿。
directions.why_now_en: Blackholes received a 7/10 score on Hacker News, indicating genuine market demand. However, it's macOS-only, leaving Linux/Windows users and cross-platform needs unaddressed. Commenters explicitly stated 'I wish this worked on Linux' and 'need this for my WSL setup', showing clear willingness to pay for a cross-platform version.
directions.monetization: 免费个人版（1个仓库）+ 付费 Pro 版 $12/月（无限仓库、团队协作、CI/CD 集成）
directions.monetization_en: Free personal tier (1 repo) + Pro tier at $12/month (unlimited repos, team collaboration, CI/CD integration)
directions.source_article: Show HN: Blackholes – A macOS workspace for coding agents
